        s.add(X[i][j] >= 1, X[i][j] <= 36)

import numpy as np

def is_magic_square(grid):
    grid = np.array(grid).reshape(6,6)
    magic_sum = 111
    # Check rows
    if not np.all(np.sum(grid, axis=1) == magic_sum):
        return False
    # Check columns
    if not np.all(np.sum(grid, axis=0) == magic_sum):
        return False
    # Check diagonals
    if np.trace(grid) != magic_sum or np.trace(np.fliplr(grid)) != magic_sum:
        return False
    return True
